title: FBLA competition apps
summary: Four full-stack web apps I built solo for FBLA programming events. Every one placed at the state or national level.

items.name: Financial Tracker
items.desc: Budgeting app with an AI chatbot for spending insights and OCR receipt scanning that logs transactions automatically.

items.name: Lost & Found
items.desc: Matches a lost-item report to the closest found item, with in-app chat so people can arrange the handoff.

items.name: Local Business Finder
items.desc: Job board and business directory with coupon filters, an event-vendor application flow, and sentiment scoring on reviews.

items.name: GPA Calculator
items.desc: Tracks GPA over time and recommends resources to help students raise their grades.

highlight: Source is moving to GitHub; links coming soon.

title: Neural network from scratch
summary: A neural network written in plain Python, with no ML libraries: forward pass, backpropagation, and gradient descent built by hand.
highlight: The point is to understand what a framework does under the hood before relying on one.

title: Drag reduction with vortex generators
summary: An independent CFD study on the DrivAer fastback car model, testing where vortex generators actually reduce drag.
highlight: Compared several placements against a baseline; the best configuration cut the average drag coefficient by about 11%.
